comments.author: Therkelsen
comments.body_html:
I have two things:

1. The MOA seems really low for this weapon. It’s a bolt action inside of an AK chassis, it should be more accurate. 7.62x39 bolties tend to be around 1-1.5 MOA.
2. The malfunction chance is REALLY high. It’s almost 23% (0.2277), did you perhaps forget a zero? (0.02277)
(overall, consider lowering your malfunctions on some of the weapons. more than like 1% is insanely high)
Turns out the malfunction stuff was a product of the new realism update, my bad!
